title: Synthetic certified hydropower repair benchmark
description: Independent synthetic benchmark accompanying Certified Affine Production Bounds for Local Hydropower Schedule Repair in the Rio Negro Cascade. Includes three development cases and twelve fixed verification examples, generated inputs and initial MILP witnesses, exact-rational certificate checks and open-source replay of 192 LP solves. New coefficients retain the same polynomial family; no restricted real-bank inputs or inherited native code are included. The protocol records an implementation correction and does not claim prospectively untouched statistical validation. Version 1.1.0 additionally verifies full Taylor storage derivatives, eight/twelve/twelve finite candidates, an essential interior-volume witness and matched fixed/full affine comparisons. The 192 original LP replays are retained and 36 full-state LPs added. Version 1.2.0 additionally supplies a complete rational outer-bound example: three outer LPs, one certified inner LP, two exact feasible reference points, an independent standard-library-only whole-box Bernstein/dual/witness verifier, six adversarial tests and complete input/certificate files. All earlier scientific files remain unchanged. The full replay has 232 LP solves; normalized gap caps use the all-demand failure penalty and concern the continuous reference optimum in fixed local boxes.
